Positive fixture: canonical 4ddb29fb, programs 071ecdac/f36c5831 and CLIFFORD-RECIPES d0768f21 regenerated from committed bytes; independent HPE-aware extended-label check 0 violations in both orientations and two readings, exact scalar shadow, 224 non-identity endpoint monomials, patched Lemma G checker 0 violations. Failure controls: 28 forward and 27 backward label-checker edits rejected under both readings plus one strict-only edit; the three admission mutants X, Y, Z (accepted by the pinned frame-only replay; rejected by both label checkers and by the recommended adapter rule; exact witnesses); every one of the 32 single-clause weakenings of the label checker re-run on all 62 pinned inputs (31 change a pinned value; the redundant survivor is pinned); the published checker's parse failure and 96 stripped-field violations; the patched checker's own 5 mutants. Every number is compared with EXPECTED.json.

Optimisation control: the same verifier under -O must reach the same EXPECTED.json result, because every package check raises ValueError and the pinned producer scripts run in separate -I -B subprocesses with their assertions active.
